note: Camping here is beside the area's two small gravel parking lots, each marked by MDC for primitive camping: this one at the north-west corner off 150th Street and one on the east side off Nodaway-Atchison Road. No pads, tables or toilets, and vehicles must stay on the gravel. No open fires. Rolling loess-hill prairie with a few small fishing ponds. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: lot camping that MDC designates (map Primitive Camping symbol beside each of the two Parking Lot symbols; a GIS camping point beside each lot) - stays under the Lick Creek reading of the lot rule. Lots and nothing more. Phone matches. No split.
flags: LOT RULE - STAYS, OWNER TO CONFIRM: the brochure says 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map' and 'Motor vehicles are allowed only on graveled public roadways and parking areas unless otherwise posted'. The 12/28/2021 map shows two Parking Lot symbols, each with a Primitive Camping symbol beside it; GIS layer 27 has a 'Primitive Camping Area' point by each: 252 at 40.50767,-95.21646 (57 m east of lot 801) and 253 at 40.50665,-95.20276 (about 60 m north-west of lot 802). On imagery each is a gravel pad roughly 20 x 15 m - the west one at the end of a 60 m gravel spur off 150th Street, the east one just off Nodaway-Atchison Road - and each GIS point falls in open mown grass beside its lot with nothing built. Neither is a built camp; neither is the main one.
PIN (optional move): stored 40.50767,-95.21646 is the west GIS camping point, in open grass 57 m east of the lot. A rig has to stay on the gravel, so the lot itself is 40.50763,-95.21713.
BROCHURE RULE: 'No open fires.' Put in the note.
NO SPLIT: the east lot is 1.2 km away on its own road but is a single small lot. Nothing else in the database within 2.5 km.
ACCESS: gravel county roads (150th Street, Nodaway-Atchison Road) from Route C; no posted limit or 4WD wording on the page, brochure or map.
PHONE: stored 816-271-3100 matches the page's 'For more information call (816) 271-3100'.
Stored year_round (manual) not contradicted; the brochure gives no camping season.
